# axm agents list

List coding-agent harnesses configured for AXM

## When to use

List coding-agent harnesses configured for AXM

## Usage

```bash
axm agents list [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

| Name          | Type    | Required | Description                                                                             |
| ------------- | ------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--scope`     | choice  | No       | List agents from project (default) or user-level configuration (choices: project, user) |
| `--detected`  | boolean | No       | Show detected agents only                                                               |
| `--available` | boolean | No       | Show all supported agent IDs                                                            |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Show configured and detected coding agents**

```bash
axm agents list
```

**Show every supported agent ID**

```bash
axm agents list --available
```

**Show detected coding agents**

```bash
axm agents list --detected
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
